claim: The CLI finds missing, extra, type, and approved non-secret value differences.
sandbox: Rust fixture creates two fingerprints and asserts every difference class

claim: The one-click browser sample immediately shows five real differences.
sandbox: fresh browser context opens ?demo=1, checks five named rows, then checks edited inputs change the result

claim: Each fingerprint is signed and tampering is rejected.
sandbox: create and verify a fingerprint, change its environment label, and assert verification fails

claim: Fingerprints do not record raw environment values.
sandbox: capture sentinel secrets and recursively scan both fingerprints and process output

claim: The site has no analytics or third-party requests, and browser demo edits are not saved.
sandbox: fresh browser context edits sentinel data; assert an allowlisted request set, empty cookies/storage/databases, and discard on exit

claim: The browser sample works offline after the first visit.
where: landing fact, demo offline notice, README
sandbox: fresh browser context installs the service worker, switches offline, reloads ?demo=1, and observes five differences

claim: Release Env Fingerprint is free under the MIT License.
sandbox: inspect the shipped LICENSE and deployed LICENSE.txt

claim: refp demo creates a temporary sample workspace without reading or writing project files.
where: CLI sample section, README, demo documentation
sandbox: run from a watched empty directory; verify it remains empty and inspect six files under the printed OS temp path

claim: The CLI exits 2 when the sample fingerprints differ.
sandbox: run refp demo and assert exit 2 plus a parsed five-difference report

claim: The policy enforces exact required variable names and required prefixes.
sandbox: Rust fixture omits both requirements and asserts both rule failures

claim: The policy accepts exact and approved subdomain hosts without recording full URLs.
sandbox: Rust matrix checks exact, subdomain, bare suffix, sibling, and lookalike hosts and scans fingerprints

claim: Only approved non-secret values receive a project-keyed hash.
sandbox: Rust fixture checks secret hash absence and different hashes under different project keys

claim: Fingerprints contain variable names, inferred types, a schema identifier, and a signature.
sandbox: Rust fixture asserts fields and inferred boolean/integer types while scanning out a sentinel URL

claim: refp --json demo emits one parseable JSON document.
sandbox: integration test parses the complete stdout document and inspects the real signed demo files

claim: refp runs the command after -- directly without shell expansion.
sandbox: capture a literal shell metacharacter payload and assert its attempted marker file is never created

claim: The repository installs one refp executable with working help.
sandbox: install the local repository package into a fresh temporary root and run refp --help

claim: npm run build produces the release CLI and static site.
sandbox: run the documented build and assert target/release/refp plus dist/site/index.html
